summary: Date picker month restriction feature testing - All 9 features PASSED. RestrictedDatePicker component correctly enforces month-based selection when restrictedMonth prop is set (Yearly, Quarterly, Half-Yearly frequencies), and allows free navigation when not set (Monthly, Others frequencies).

yearly_frequency_month_restriction.test: Yearly frequency: After selecting month (e.g., August), calendar shows ONLY August dates
yearly_frequency_month_restriction.evidence: Calendar shows 'August 2026' header with dates 1-31, no navigation arrows visible

quarterly_frequency_month_restriction.test: Quarterly frequency: After selecting Q1 and January, calendar shows ONLY January dates
quarterly_frequency_month_restriction.evidence: Calendar shows 'January 2026' header with dates 1-31, no navigation arrows visible

half_yearly_frequency_month_restriction.test: Half-Yearly frequency: After selecting H1 and March, calendar shows ONLY March dates
half_yearly_frequency_month_restriction.evidence: Calendar shows 'March 2026' header with dates 1-31, no navigation arrows visible

monthly_frequency_no_restriction.test: Monthly frequency: Calendar has no month restriction (can navigate)
monthly_frequency_no_restriction.evidence: Calendar shows navigation arrows (left/right), month/year dropdowns visible. Navigation buttons found: 2

others_frequency_no_restriction.test: Others frequency: Calendar has no month restriction (can navigate)
others_frequency_no_restriction.evidence: Calendar shows navigation arrows, month/year dropdowns visible. Navigation buttons found: 2

no_navigation_arrows_when_restricted.test: Calendar has NO navigation arrows when month is restricted
no_navigation_arrows_when_restricted.evidence: Navigation buttons count = 0 when restrictedMonth is set (Yearly/Quarterly/Half-Yearly)

no_trailing_leading_dates_when_restricte.test: Calendar has NO trailing/leading dates from neighboring months when restricted
no_trailing_leading_dates_when_restricte.evidence: showOutsideDays={!isMonthRestricted} implemented, no outside days visible in restricted calendars

calendar_icon_on_right.test: Date picker button shows calendar icon on right
calendar_icon_on_right.evidence: CalendarIcon component positioned with ml-2 class on right side of button text

formatted_date_after_selection.test: Date picker shows formatted date after selection (e.g., 'January 15, 2026')
formatted_date_after_selection.evidence: After selecting August 15, button shows 'August 15th, 2026' using format(date, 'PPP')

job_income_page_test.evidence: Yearly frequency with August month shows calendar locked to August 2026 with no navigation buttons

critical_code_review_comments: RestrictedDatePicker component properly implemented with restrictedMonth prop
Calendar component correctly hides nav via classNames when disableNavigation=true
showOutsideDays toggled correctly based on month restriction
Date formatting uses date-fns format(date, 'PPP') for localized output
Both SelfEmployedIncome.js and JobIncome.js correctly use getMonthIndex() helper to pass restrictedMonth prop
context_for_next_testing_agent: Date picker month restriction feature complete. RestrictedDatePicker component in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/date-picker.jsx accepts restrictedMonth prop (0-11). When set, calendar hides navigation arrows, hides outside days, and restricts date selection to only the specified month. Used in SelfEmployedIncome.js and JobIncome.js for Yearly, Quarterly, and Half-Yearly frequencies. Monthly and Others frequencies have no restrictions.
